p1_new.title: MemoryController migration — in-memory → persistent
p1_new.description: Current MemoryController uses Python lists. Migration to BrainDB must preserve existing in-memory behavior during transition to avoid breaking ChiefBrainKernel.consolidate() calls.
p1_new.mitigation: Implement with feature flag: persist_to_db=True enables DB writes while keeping in-memory lists as cache. Default preserves current behavior until verified.

p2_new.title: Decay tick scheduling — not in scope
p2_new.description: Decay model defines half-life but does not define WHEN decay_tick() is called. Periodic scheduling (cron, background thread) is deferred to Phase 4 (Self Reflection Loop).
p2_new.mitigation: decay_tick() is callable on-demand. Phase 4 adds automatic scheduling. Until then, decay is applied on read (lazy decay).

p2_new.title: Brain state backup/restore — not in scope
p2_new.description: brain_state.db has no backup mechanism in Phase 1. Data loss on filesystem corruption.
p2_new.mitigation: brain_state.db is SQLite — standard backup tools work. Formal backup added in Phase 4.
